description: The Sovereign Academy is a parent education and product organization focused on personal sovereignty: the knowledge and practical ability to make important decisions with more understanding, more control, and less dependence. It operates three Sovereign Academies of equal standing — financial education (Financially Sovereign Academy), Bitcoin education (Bitcoin Sovereign Academy), and educational decision support for teachers and parents (Education Sovereign Academy).

positioning.parent_brand: The Sovereign Academy is a parent education and product organization focused on personal sovereignty. It works wherever someone must understand a system or situation well enough to decide for themselves what to do about it. Money, Bitcoin and education are current domains, not the definition of the institution. Refer to BSA, FSA and ESA as Sovereign Academies — not properties, platforms, branches, or paths.
positioning.organizing_question: How can people understand, protect, and exercise more control over important parts of their lives?
positioning.exploration_areas_note: Areas of exploration, not launched products. Describe them as such.

list.name: Financially Sovereign Academy
list.focus: Practical education for understanding and navigating money: cash flow, credit, debt, saving, investing; organizational and workforce programs

list.name: Bitcoin Sovereign Academy
list.focus: Education for understanding, owning, protecting, and passing on Bitcoin: fundamentals, self-custody, security, inheritance, Lightning Network

list.name: Education Sovereign Academy
list.focus: Tools and research that help teachers and parents understand what educational evidence may be showing and decide what is worth doing next
list.status: Public homepage live. Current research and prototypes are primarily teacher-facing; parent-facing work is stated direction, not validated or shipped.
